notes:
Summary: Mid-large fintech focused on customer support automation and compliance summarization. Initially engaged for a private/VPC deployment to meet residency and KMS controls. During procurement phase buyer committee pushed vendor simplicity + brand preference; ultimately selected direct OpenAI/Anthropic APIs for speed to production and lower perceived operational overhead.

Key quotes / call notes:
- 'We need something that our infra team can roll out in 2 weeks — minimal ops.' (Head of Infra, 2025-02-11)
- 'Brand trust and SDK maturity weighed heavily in the decision.' (VP Product)

Timeline (recent):
- 2024-10-15: Lead created after conference intro (AE Alex Harper).
- 2024-11-03: Discovery call — captured security checklist and residency requirements. Fireflies: ff_2024-11-03_1430.
- 2024-12-09: Architecture workshop with Priya Nair (SE). Verified VPC/KMS path; provided private deployment runbook.
- 2025-01-14: Pricing + contract sent; procurement requested vendor SOC2 + ISO attestation. Shared security FAQ (drive link).
- 2025-02-11: Final eval call; infra wanted minimal infra work; buyer favored direct OpenAI/Anthropic due to perceived lower ops burden (Fireflies: ff_2025-02-11_0918).
- 2025-02-18: AE note: procurement confirms they will go with OpenAI + Anthropic direct APIs; budget cycle tight and no internal champion to drive private deployment. Marking as closed-lost.

POC / Technical:
- POC prototypes ran with Redwood hosted API latency within SLO but infra team flagged vendor key-management compatibility (HSM certs) as risk.
- Experimented with batching and prefix caching recommendations; ops overhead still a concern for them.

Next actions / playbook:
- Close as lost; nurture for 6–9 months.
- Share shortened ROI brief highlighting managed fallbacks, long-term cost of direct APIs at scale vs reserved capacity.
- Target contact: Head of Infra and Head of AI platform — re-open after next budget cycle or if hiring for security champion.

Internal AE/SE notes (shorthand):
- Pricing did not break them but perception of vendor operational burden did.
- Decision driven by simplicity + brand (OpenAI/Anthropic) + procurement risk appetite.
- Keep on quarterly churn watch.
